output.markdown:
# Change documentation

## Overview

Requirement: Make links expire. Clarification: Expiration is optional per link: the client may supply an absolute expiration time when creating a link; after that time the link returns the expired result; links without an expiration never expire; existing links are unaffected.

Normalized: make links expire clarification expiration is optional per link the client may supply an absolute expiration time when creating a link after that time the link returns the expired result links without an expiration never expire existing links are unaffected

Capabilities: [EXPIRATION]

## Behavior

- EXPIRATION B1: a client may optionally supply an absolute expiration time per link
- EXPIRATION B2: it must be in the future
- EXPIRATION B3: after it, the link returns an expired result distinct from not-found, with no redirect and no count
- EXPIRATION B4: a link without an expiration never expires (existing links are unaffected)

## API

- POST /api/links (expiresAt)
- GET /r/{code} (410 Gone)

## Data

- link.expires_at (V3__link_expiration.sql)

## Implementation

Revision: null

Summary: No code change: the clarified behavior (optional absolute expiration per link, 410 after expiry, links without expiration never expire, existing links unaffected) is already implemented by SCN-B commit b3d0b8d.

Changed artifacts:
- none

Designed components cited by the evidence: []

Designed components not cited: [Link, LinkService, LinkController, RedirectController]

## Validation

Planned tests and acceptance probes:
- LinkExpirationTest
- probe.expired-link

SECURITY probes the validator with unsafe inputs; TEST runs the acceptance probes on the running build.

## Traceability

Requirement IDs: [FR-URL-008, FR-URL-009]
- TASK-1 (EXPIRATION): [FR-URL-008, FR-URL-009] checked by [probe.expired-link]

## Limitations

- No authentication; actor types are self-declared (EXC-003).
- Host names that resolve to private addresses are not blocked; only literals are checked (EXC-009).
- Implementation evidence is self-reported; TEST and SECURITY verify behavior, not the revision.
